name: Default
shortDescription: Proxy server that solves Cloudflare and DDoS-GUARD challenges with headless Chromium and returns the page HTML and cookies, for Prowlarr, Jackett and other HTTP clients.

alerts.message: FlareSolverr has no authentication, so this template only answers under a secret path. Use https://<your-domain>/<FLARESOLVERR_TOKEN>/ as the FlareSolverr URL in Prowlarr or Jackett, where the token is the generated value in the environment settings; every other path returns 404. Keep the token private: anyone who has it can make the server browse any URL.
